cases.sentence: И Левину вспомнилась ___ с Долли и ее детьми.
cases.explain: «недавняя сцена» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: And Levin remembered a scene he had lately witnessed between Dolly and her children. The children, left to themselves, had begun cooking raspberries over the candles and squirting milk into each other’s mouths with a syringe. Their mother, catching them at these pranks, began reminding them in Levin’s presence of the trouble their mischief gave to the grown-up people, and that this trouble was all for their sake, and that if they smashed the cups they would have nothing to drink their tea out of, and that if they wasted the milk, they would have nothing to eat, and die of hunger.

cases.sentence: Они только были огорчены тем, что прекращена их ___, и не верили ни слову из того, что говорила мать.
cases.explain: «занимательная игра» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: And Levin had been struck by the passive, weary incredulity with which the children heard what their mother said to them. They were simply annoyed that their amusing play had been interrupted, and did not believe a word of what their mother was saying. They could not believe it indeed, for they could not take in the immensity of all they habitually enjoyed, and so could not conceive that what they were destroying was the very thing they lived by.

cases.sentence: Ну-ка, пустите нас с нашими страстями, мыслями, без понятия о ___ и творце!
cases.explain: «едином боге» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Now then, leave the children to themselves to get things alone and make their crockery, get the milk from the cows, and so on. Would they be naughty then? Why, they’d die of hunger! Well, then, leave us with our passions and thoughts, without any idea of the one God, of the Creator, or without any idea of what is right, without any idea of moral evil.

cases.sentence: «Разве я не знаю, что это – ___ и что оно не круглый свод?
cases.explain: «бесконечное пространство» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Lying on his back, he gazed up now into the high, cloudless sky. “Do I not know that that is infinite space, and that it is not a round arch? But, however I screw up my eyes and strain my sight, I cannot see it not round and not bounded, and in spite of my knowing about infinite space, I am incontestably right when I see a solid blue dome, and more right than when I strain my eyes to see beyond it.”

cases.sentence: Левин перестал уже думать и только как бы прислушивался к ___, о чем-то радостно и озабоченно переговаривавшимся между собой.
cases.explain: «таинственным голосам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Levin ceased thinking, and only, as it were, listened to mysterious voices that seemed talking joyfully and earnestly within him.
